title: Modern Marketing
sources_used: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Define modern marketing? [U] / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Modern marketing focuses on creating value for customers by understanding their needs and
  • building long -term relationships. It uses technology, data, and customer insights to deliver
  • personalised experiences. It moves beyond selling products to satisfying customer expectations.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Define customer journey mapping. [U] / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Customer journey mapping is the process of visualising every step a customer takes from
  • awareness to purchase and beyond. It helps businesses understand customer needs, pain points,
  • and interactions. This enables better service design and improved customer experience.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain the speciality of Personas in marketing. [U] / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Personas are fictional profiles representing different types of customers. They help marketers
  • understand customer motivations, preferences, and behaviours. This leads to more targeted and
  • effective marketing strategies.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Define mobile marketing. [U] / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Mobile marketing involves promoting products and services through mobile devices like
  • smartphones and tablets. It uses SMS, apps, mobile ads, and location -based services to reach
  • customers instantly. It enables personalised and real-time communication.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain the significance of display ads in marketing. [U] / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Display ads help businesses gain visibility by appearing on websites, apps, and social platforms.
  • They use visuals, animations, and short messages to attract customer attention. Display ads support
  • brand awareness even if users do not click immediately. They target audiences based on interests,
  • behaviour, or demographics. Retargeting through display ads reminds users of products they
  • viewed earlier. This results in higher engagement and improved conversions.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Break down the components of a microenvironment and explain how each affects
questions.solution_html:
• decision-making. [An] / [CO1]
  • The microenvironment consists of customers, competitors, suppliers, interme diaries, and the
  • company itself. Customers influence decisions because their preferences determine product
  • features and pricing. Competitors push the company to innovate and adopt better strategies.
  • Suppliers affect production quality, cost, and availabili ty of materials. Intermediaries like
  • distributors and retailers influence how products reach customers. The company’s internal
  • environment—employees, departments, and culture —shapes marketing decisions and overall
  • performance.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain customer journey mapping and its importance. [U] / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Customer journey mapping is a visual representation of all the interactions a customer has with a
  • brand. It includes stages like awareness, consideration, purchase, and post -purchase. The map
  • helps identify customer needs and expectations at each stage. It also highlights pain points or gaps
  • in service delivery. Businesses use this insight to improve the overall customer experience. This
  • leads to better satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term engagement.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
